correctness.rationale: Independently checked normalized U0=0,U1=1,V0=V1=2 and W_{n+2}=2W_{n+1}+W_n. For odd p the quadratic-unit ratio alpha/beta has order r|p-(2/p); odd-prime lifting in the unramified quadratic extension gives v_p(U_n)=e+v_p(n/r) if r|n and v_p(V_n)=h+v_p(n/t) on odd multiples of t=r/2 for even r. Möbius inversion of these indicator-supported p-powers yields the full positive U and alternating signed V support and sharp K=r/gcd(r,p-1) (or 1 for odd-rank V). Signs give no V realizability after positive scaling when r even. At p=2, v_2(U_n)=v_2(n), v_2(V_n)=1. Frobenius and quadratic-reciprocity parity classify Dold residue classes and Dirichlet supplies stated densities. Independent integer Mobius inversions verified 5,040 direct checks for primes <=43, indices <=180 against closed formulas. Finite checks are not proof of all primes.
